name: navx-monorepo
description: NAVX — the modern, RTL-native, accessible navigation library.

scripts.//preview: Rebuilds the packages the page inlines, then the page, then serves. Skipping the package build is how a preview ends up showing yesterday stylesheet inside today HTML.
scripts.//package: `run publint`, not `exec publint`: @navx/angular publishes from dist/ (ng-packagr writes the real manifest there), so only the package itself knows which directory to lint. `exec` checked its source folder and reported a false suggestion while leaving the published artifact unchecked.
scripts.package: turbo run build && pnpm --filter "./packages/*" run publint && pnpm --filter "./packages/*" run attw
scripts.verify: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm package && pnpm size
